# XlsxWriter reference files

These `.xlsx` files were created by Microsoft Excel and come from the
[XlsxWriter](https://github.com/jmcnamara/XlsxWriter) test suite
(`xlsxwriter/test/comparison/xlsx_files/`). They are used under the BSD
2-Clause license in `LICENSE.txt`, copyright John McNamara.

`scripts/golden.py` compares our output with them part by part.
